items.rationale: Rainwater entered from outside, so this is surface flooding under §2.5, not escape of water under §2.4. No further natural hazards cover is evidenced, so §3.6.2(b) bars the labour; the conditional estimate is 12 hours × €90 gross.
Section 3.6.2(f) bars all journey charges for the flood claim. If flood cover were confirmed, this first listed journey could qualify under §7.1.7(g) at about €65 gross.
Section 3.6.2(d) bars the charge on this claim, and §5.2.2 independently excludes separate pump procurement alongside billed water extraction. The positive figure is a nominal estimate only.
Section 3.6.2(d) bars the charge, and §5.2.2 treats the pump as working equipment included in the extraction measure, not as a separate payable item. The positive figure is a nominal estimate only.
Sections 3.6.2(d) and 5.1 bar mitigation costs without evidenced flood cover. If covered, §5.2.2 would allow about €450 gross for the extraction as a single measure including labour and equipment.
Section 3.6.2(c) bars materials for this flood claim. If covered, §7.1.7(c) would allow about €100 gross for standard materials actually installed in the damaged circuits.

items.description: Boiler, flue and storage tank renewal
items.rationale: The boiler system is insured building plant, but §3.6.2(a) bars its replacement when flood cover is not evidenced. The conditional estimate under §7.1.1(c) is €9,500 gross for like-for-like replacement and installation, excluding the separately billed adaptation and disposal.
Section 3.6.2(a) expressly bars adaptation work on this claim. If covered, §7.1.7(d) would allow about €650 gross for necessary changes to the immediately adjoining connections.
Section 3.6.2(e) bars disposal on this claim. If covered, §5.2.1 would allow about €350 gross for ordinary removal, haulage and disposal of the unusable plant, with no duplicate recovery.
Section 3.6.2(f) bars the charge, and §7.1.8(d) independently excludes a second journey charge for the same event. The positive figure is a nominal estimate only.
